summary: The three derived types are now factory-only and fail closed. There is no caller-supplied retained state, no projection-logic injection point, no exception-name heuristic, and no way to reach a learned route without an owner-derived obligation.

enforcement_points.refused: direct construction with any caller-chosen retained_state

enforcement_points.guard: LEARNED route requires a non-None obligation

enforcement_points.exception: cannot be constructed in the first place

typed_owner_factories.from_adaptive_result: classify_adaptive_coverage(completeness_state); carries the owner's own unvisited/visited/determinant refs
typed_owner_factories.from_recursive_handoff: a real handoff plus its owner-derived coverage custody -> SUPPORTED

refusal_typing.subclass_hazard: Pre553AuthorityError subclasses Pre553IntegrityError, so an isinstance check would collapse BLOCKED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY into INTEGRITY_FAILURE. Exact-type identity is required, and the integrity factory refuses a Pre553AuthorityError outright.
refusal_typing.removed: from_owner_refusal and all class-name substring classification

custody_identity.handoff_scope_identity: deterministic content hashes of candidate_universe_definition, winning_predicate, discovery_authority_ref, branch_replay_binding
custody_identity.completeness_state: REMOVED - RecursiveBranchHandoff does not own a completeness grade
